dual_answer_possible.detail: All 20 questions have exactly one defensible answer. No ambiguous cases found.

answer_leakage.detail: Q7 interpretation appears as 'Interpretation' in last sentence (capitalized), and Q8 outcome appears later in 'interpret the outcome'. Both are inherent to fullPassage-based questions; blanks are correctly placed and students must still identify the right word from context. Acceptable for 단어 test.

choice_exploits.detail: No length bias (S-LENGTH-BIAS). No prefix dominance (S-PREFIX-DOMINANT). No obvious elimination patterns. ABC choices properly shuffled with one error per distractor.

marker_distribution.detail: Q4 markers: ①2nd sentence, ②2nd sentence, ③3rd sentence, ④5th sentence — distributed across passage. Q5 markers: ①2nd sentence, ②2nd sentence, ③5th sentence, ④5th sentence — slight clustering but acceptable. Q6 markers: ①1st sentence, ②2nd sentence, ③4th sentence, ④5th sentence — well distributed.

antonym_prefix_check.detail: Q13 desired↔dreaded: semantic antonym (not prefix manipulation). Q14 former↔latter: classical pair (not prefix). No S-ANTONYM-PREFIX violation.

written_answer_check.detail: Q17 wa=interpretation, not in passage (passage is excerpt). Q18 wa=consistently, not in passage (passage is excerpt). No S-WA-IN-PASSAGE issue.

meta_choice_check.detail: No choices contain meta-descriptive language (본문에서/다루지 않은/관련 없는). All choices are concrete words or phrases.

cheese_gate_check.detail: All MC questions require passage reading to answer. No question solvable by elimination alone without passage context.

summary: No HIGH or MEDIUM issues. 1 LOW note about inherent word repetition in fullPassage (Q7/Q8 answer words appear elsewhere in passage — unavoidable with short 153-word passage, blanks correctly placed). Test is ready for deployment.
